dedupe_keys.name: chinese transmission infrastructure embodied carbon inventory 2015

description: This research inventory estimates embodied carbon for 191 typical electricity-transmission infrastructure projects in China in 2015. It includes 145 alternating-current line designs, 37 alternating-current substations, eight direct-current line designs and one direct-current converter-station design. The authors publish the dataset as a RAR package on Figshare under CC BY 4.0, allowing free access and reuse. Coverage is a set of representative project types for one accounting year, not a geospatial census or a live operational emissions feed. The own landing metadata establishes the project counts but does not expose the inner table structure without opening the package. These values can parameterize embodied-emissions consequences in network-expansion and infrastructure-transition simulations, complementing network topology resources such as data-re-europe. A caveat is that designs and supply-chain intensities may change across countries and years. Typical-project totals also require a documented scaling rule before applying them to a specific asset. The archive was not downloaded, and its numerical results were not recalculated.
